subject: Request: Comprehensive third-party dependency inventory & egress topology
messages:
From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@finbridge.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: security@finbridge.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Inventory & egress topology for DPA review

Hi Lauren,

We're preparing for an upcoming DPA review and audit at FinBridge. As part of that work we need a current, machine-readable inventory of Redwood's third-party dependencies that handle FinBridge data, plus a simple egress topology map that shows where data may leave the EU/US boundary (if applicable). Specifically we're asking for: 

- A CSV (or Excel) listing each third party with: vendor name, role (e.g., telemetry, metrics, CDN), approximate data types processed, country of processing, contractual subprocessor clause reference (if any), and whether KMS/HSM keys are used.
- A one-page egress topology diagram or a short bullet list showing flows that could result in cross-border transfer.
- Any recent changes in the last 90 days and an indication of whether backups or observability pipelines use different processors.

We have attached our DDQ and a small template you can populate to save time. Can you get us a first pass by EOD Friday (2026-09-04)? If that timeline doesn't work, please propose the earliest date you can share a draft.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Alex Byrne
Senior Security Manager | FinBridge
Attachment: finbridge_ddq_v2.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@finbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Inventory & egress topology for DPA review

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can support this; looping in Kimberly (security/compliance) and Irene (privacy) to pull our canonical export and confirm egress notes.

Quick plan:
- I'll export our current 3P inventory and populate your template with the fields you've listed.
- Kimberly will validate processing locations and whether any telemetry or observability pipelines introduce additional processors.
- Irene will confirm contractual references and call out any recent subprocessor changes.

We have an export that covers the fields you requested — attaching a CSV snapshot to speed the work. We'll aim to get a draft into your template by Friday EOD, but if we hit blockers (legal signoffs or vendor confirmation) we'll send a partial deliverable earlier.

Can you confirm whether FinBridge needs the topology expressed as a Visio/PNG or if bullets are acceptable? Also, is the scope limited to production processors or do you need staging/test environments included?

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Privacy Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_3p_export_20260831.csv
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Inventory & egress topology for DPA review — action items

FYI — FinBridge (Alex Byrne) needs a populated inventory template + egress notes by Friday. Key asks below (copied from original):

- Vendor, role, data types, country of processing, subprocessor clause reference, KMS/HSM usage
- Call out any recent changes in last 90 days
- Note telemetry/backups that may use different processors

Proposed split:
- Kimberly: confirm processing countries and telemetry/backups scope, and flag any vendors with transient access (temp tokens/escrow).
- Irene: check contract clause references and whether any recent subprocessor additions require a DPA addendum.
- I'll run the export against our canonical inventory and start filling the attached template.

If either of you needs vendor confirmation, say so and I'll open the outreach thread (I prefer to keep vendor emails minimal until we have a consolidated ask).

Action items (please reply inline):
- Kimberly — earliest ETA for your checks?
- Irene — any contract-side blockers we should expect?

Thanks — will assemble once we have your inputs.

— Lauren
From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@finbridge.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: security@finbridge.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Inventory & egress topology for DPA review

Thanks Lauren — bullets are fine (PNG optional). Staging/test can be excluded from the initial deliverable; we'll ask for any gaps later.

A couple of follow-ups from Legal: can you also indicate the contractual status for each processor (covered by Redwood's DPA, covered by vendor's own DPA, or processing under a passthrough) and whether any vendor has access to raw request/response payloads? Those two fields are critical for our reviewers.

If you can include those in the CSV by Friday EOD that would be ideal. If not, send what you have and flag missing cells.

Appreciate the collaboration.

Alex
